title: release/release-manifest.json
description: Validates release/release-manifest.json, produced by `make docs` and by the release workflow. Enforced by scripts/validate-manifests.py in `make check`: against the real file when a build has run, and always against schemas/fixtures/, so the schema is exercised on a clean clone rather than sitting unenforced until release day. Its job is to make a PDF traceable to the commit and the toolchain that produced it.

dirty.description: True when the working tree had uncommitted changes at build time. A dirty release artefact is not reproducible and the manifest says so rather than hiding it.

source_date_epoch.description: The timestamp stamped into the PDFs. Pinned so that the same revision produces the same bytes; without it typst records the moment of the build and every digest below changes on every run.

source_date_epoch_from.description: Where that timestamp came from. `clock` means the build was not reproducible - an untracked tree - and the manifest says so rather than implying otherwise.

max_overhang_pt.description: Worst distance in PDF points that any glyph reaches past the right text edge. Recorded rather than merely checked, so a release can be audited for how close it came to the tolerance instead of only whether it passed. Justified text with hyphenation lets a hyphen hang slightly, so a small positive value is normal; see OVERFLOW_TOL_PT in scripts/build-docs.py.
